papers.title: Validation of the Scottish epilepsy deaths study (SEDS) score using routinely collected data in Wales: a retrospective cohort study.
papers.title_zh: 使用威尔士常规收集的数据验证苏格兰癫痫死亡研究（ SEDS ）评分：一项回顾性队列研究。
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: The Scottish Epilepsy Deaths Study (SEDS) Score was developed to identify individuals at increased risk of epilepsy-related death. We externally validated the SEDS Score within the Welsh Population using the Secure Anonymised Information Linkage (SAIL) databank.
METHODS: This is a retrospective cohort study of adults (≥18 years) with epilepsy living in Wales, 2015-2019. Five annual cohorts were created, with individuals followed for one year. Epilepsy-related deaths were defined as deaths with epilepsy recorded on death certificates. SEDS Scores were calculated for all individuals at the beginning of each cohort year and used to categorise low, medium, high, and very-high risk groups based on individual SEDS Scores. We used logistic regression to compare odds-ratios (ORs) for epilepsy-related death in each of the SEDS Score risk groups.
RESULTS: We found 423 epilepsy-related deaths amongst 117,724 epilepsy person-years. An increasing SEDS Score was associated with increasing risk of epilepsy-related death. Odds ratios (95% confidence intervals) for epilepsy-related deaths within one year (compared to the reference category (SEDS Score = 0)) for low, medium, high and very high-risk SEDS Score categories were 4.5 (1.6-10.0); 1.3 (1.0-1.7); 3.2 (2.4-4.3); and 7.6 (5.6-10.4) respectively.
CONCLUSION: The SEDS Score demonstrates predictive value in identifying individuals at higher risk of epilepsy-related death within the Welsh population. SEDS Score performed particularly well for the high and very high-risk categories and may help prioritise targeted preventative interventions.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：苏格兰癫痫死亡研究（ SEDS ）评分旨在识别癫痫相关死亡风险增加的个体。 我们使用安全匿名信息链接（ SAIL ）数据库对威尔士人群中的SEDS分数进行了外部验证。
方法：这是一项2015-2019年威尔士成人（ ≥ 18岁）癫痫患者的回顾性队列研究。 创建了五个年度队列，个体随访一个
年。癫痫相关死亡定义为死亡证明上记录的癫痫死亡。 在每个队列年初为所有个体计算SEDS评分，并用于根据个人SEDS评分对低、中、高和极高风险组进行分类。 我们使用逻辑回归比较了每个SEDS评分风险组中癫痫相关死亡的比值比（ OR ）。
结果：我们发现423个与癫痫相关的DEA
117,724人-年。 SEDS评分增加与癫痫相关死亡风险增加相关。 低、中、高和极高风险SEDS评分类别的一年内癫痫相关死亡的优势比（ 95%置信区间）分别为4.5 （ 1.6-10.0 ）、1.3 （ 1.0-1.7 ）、3.2 （ 2.4-4.3 ）和7.6 （ 5.6-10.4 ）。
结论： SEDS分数演示
在识别威尔士人群中癫痫相关死亡风险较高的个体方面具有预测价值。SEDS评分在高风险和极高风险类别中表现特别好，可能有助于优先考虑有针对性的预防干预措施。

papers.title: Real-world efficacy and safety profile of sulthiame treatment in drug-resistant childhood epilepsy.
papers.title_zh: Sulthiame治疗耐药性儿童癫痫的真实疗效和安全性。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Sulthiame (STM) is a potent carbonic anhydrase inhibitor primarily used in focal epilepsy syndromes; however, clinical data regarding its efficacy and safety in broader drug-resistant childhood epilepsy remain limited. This study aimed to evaluate the clinical efficacy, electroencephalographic response, and safety profile of STM in a cohort of pediatric patients with drug-resistant epilepsy.
METHODS: A retrospective medical chart review was conducted for patients under 18 years of age treated with STM at a tertiary pediatric neurology clinic between 2011 and 2024. Data including demographic characteristics, etiology, seizure semiology, epilepsy syndromes, treatment duration, and dosage were analyzed. Electroencephalographic (EEG) findings were assessed using EEG recordings obtained within 1-3 months after initiation of sulthiame therapy. Seizure frequency outcomes were assessed by comparing baseline seizure frequency with seizure frequency at the final available clinical follow-up.
RESULTS: Sixty-one patients (55.7% female; median seizure onset: 14 months) were included. A structural etiology was identified in 50.8% of patients, and 62.3% had a well-defined epilepsy syndrome. At the final available clinical follow-up, 41% (n = 25) of patients achieved complete seizure freedom, while 16.4% (n = 10) showed a ≥ 50% reduction in seizure frequency. Conversely, 42.6% demonstrated a < 50% reduction. A higher number of previously failed anti-seizure medications (ASMs) was significantly associated with a poorer treatment response (p = 0.014). EEG improvement was observed in 44.3% of the cohort. Notably, focal seizure semiology was associated with favorable EEG outcomes, whereas combined semiology was linked to electroencephalographic worsening (p = 0.026). STM was generally well-tolerated; adverse effects were reported in only nine patients, with treatment discontinuation required in only two cases (3.2%).
CONCLUSIONS: Sulthiame is an effective and well-tolerated therapeutic option for children with drug-resistant epilepsy, particularly those with focal semiology. Our findings suggest that a higher burden of prior ASM treatment negatively impacts response rates, highlighting the potential benefit of considering STM earlier in the treatment algorithm for specific pediatric populations.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：舒硫酸（ STM ）是一种有效的碳酸酐酶抑制剂，主要用于局灶性癫痫综合征；然而，关于其在更广泛的耐药性儿童癫痫中的疗效和安全性的临床数据仍然有限。 本研究旨在评估STM在儿科耐药性癫痫患者队列中的临床疗效、脑电图反应和安全性。
方法：回顾性医学图表revie
w是在2011年至2024年期间在三级儿科神经病学诊所接受STM治疗的18岁以下患者中进行的。分析数据包括人口统计学特征、病因、癫痫症状、癫痫综合征、治疗持续时间和剂量。使用在开始氨基磺酸盐治疗后1-3个月内获得的脑电图记录来评估脑电图（ EEG ）结果。评估癫痫发作频率结局
d通过在最终可用的临床随访中比较基线癫痫发作频率和癫痫发作频率。
结果：纳入61例患者（ 55.7%为女性；中位癫痫发作： 14个月）。 在50.8%的患者中发现了结构性病因， 62.3%的患者有明确的癫痫综合征。 在最终可用的临床随访中， 41 ％ （ n = 25 ）的患者实现了完全的癫痫发作自由，而16.4 ％ （ n = 10 ）显示出≥ 50 ％的减少
癫痫发作频率。相反， 42.6%显示减少< 50%。较高数量的先前失败的抗癫痫药物（ ASM ）与较差的治疗反应显著相关（ p = 0.014 ）。在44.3%的队列中观察到脑电图改善。值得注意的是，局灶性癫痫发作符号学与良好的脑电图结果相关，而合并符号学与脑电图恶化相关（ p = 0.026 ）。STM是
耐受性良好；仅在9名患者中报告了不良反应，仅在2例患者中需要停药（ 3.2% ）。
结论：舒硫酸是一种有效且耐受性良好的治疗选择，适用于耐药性癫痫儿童，尤其是具有局灶性符号学的儿童。 我们的研究结果表明，较高的既往ASM治疗负担会对缓解率产生负面影响，突出了考虑
ng STM在特定儿科人群的治疗算法中较早出现。

papers.title: Socioeconomic deprivation and spatial inequalities in epilepsy-related mortality in Peru: A national ecological study, 2017-2023.
papers.title_zh: 秘鲁癫痫相关死亡率的社会经济剥夺和空间不平等：国家生态研究， 2017-2023年。
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Epilepsy-related mortality may reflect socioeconomic and territorial inequalities, as well as disparities in access to healthcare. Subnational evidence from Latin America remains limited.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate socioeconomic and spatial inequalities in epilepsy-related mortality across provinces in Peru.
METHODS: A national ecological study using SINADEF data from 2017 to 2023 was conducted. Epilepsy-related mortality was defined as any mention of ICD-10 codes G40-G41. Provincial deprivation combined poverty, rurality, and low educational attainment using principal component analysis. Official annual provincial population denominators, age-standardized rates, the slope index of inequality (SII), relative index of inequality (RII), negative binomial regression, and a Bayesian BYM2 model were used. Code-specific negative-binomial sensitivity analyses evaluated G40 and G41 separately.
RESULTS: A total of 4547 deaths across 196 provinces were analyzed. The age-standardized mortality rate was 1.99 per 100,000 person-years and increased from 1.73 in the least deprived quintile to 2.98 in the most deprived quintile (Q5/Q1 =1.73). The RII was 1.81 (95% CI 1.34-2.45), and the SII was + 1.27 per 100,000 person-years (95% CI 0.64-1.91). In the BYM2 model, each 1-SD increase in deprivation was associated with 18% higher mortality (RR 1.18; 95% CrI 1.10-1.27; P[RR>1]=1.00). G40 was mentioned in 4196 deaths and G41 in 507; 156 certificates contained both. In code-specific sensitivity models, the deprivation association persisted for G40 (RR 1.19; 95% CI 1.11-1.27) and G41 (RR 1.34; 95% CI 1.20-1.49). The socioeconomic gradient persisted over time.
CONCLUSIONS: Epilepsy-related mortality showed a persistent socioeconomic and spatial gradient. Rurality was the most robust individual component, supporting the evaluation of territorial barriers to healthcare.

papers.title: MRgFUS for drug-resistant epilepsy: Preliminary report for prospective clinical trial.
papers.title_zh: MRgFUS治疗耐药性癫痫：前瞻性临床试验的初步报告。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To assess the safety, feasibility, and preliminary clinical outcomes of magnetic resonance-guided focused ultrasound (MRgFUS) for drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE).
METHODS: This TFDA-regulated, open-label study enrolled four adults with DRE. MRgFUS targeted the anterior nucleus of the thalamus (ANT), the centromedian nucleus (CM), the posterior corpus callosum (CC), or the hypothalamic hamartoma (HH). The primary endpoints were safety and feasibility, while secondary endpoints included seizure frequency, EEG results, and postoperative MRI findings.
RESULTS: The mean age of the patients was 34.7 years and the mean SDR was 0.38. Two of the procedures were performed under local anesthesia and three under general anesthesia. No serious adverse events, permanent neurological deficit, or postoperative cognitive decline were observed. At follow-up ranging from 3 to 15 months, seizure outcomes varied. The CM-treated patient showed stable overall seizure frequency with a 42.6% reduction in focal seizures. Posterior CC lesioning reduced interhemispheric EEG synchrony and was associated with a 15.9% reduction in generalized seizures. The HH case displayed a decrease in epileptiform activity on EEG and a 55.5% reduction of gelastic seizures, despite the absence of a definitive lesion. In the ANT case, the initial procedure was discontinued prior to reaching therapeutic temperatures, and the repeat treatment under general anesthesia was associated with a 66.0% seizure reduction at final follow-up.
CONCLUSIONS: MRgFUS achieved lesion formation at selected epilepsy-related targets, including the first reported applications to the posterior CC and CM for epilepsy. However, the ability to achieve therapeutic temperatures and produce a definitive lesion varied among patients and was influenced by skull characteristics of the anatomical target. Given the small, heterogeneous cohort and limited follow-up, the observed clinical outcomes should be considered preliminary. Larger studies with longer follow-up are needed to establish efficacy and optimize treatment parameters.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：评价磁共振引导聚焦超声（ MRgFUS ）治疗耐药性癫痫（ DRE ）的安全性、可行性和初步临床预后。
方法：这项TFDA调节的开放标签研究招募了四名患有DRE的成年人。 MRgFUS靶向丘脑前核（ ANT ）、居中核（ CM ）、茧后体（ CC ）或下丘脑错构瘤（ HH ）。 主要终点是安全性和
可行性，而次要终点包括癫痫发作频率、脑电图结果和术后MRI结果。
结果：患者的平均年龄为34.7岁，平均SDR为0.38。 其中两项手术在局部麻醉下进行，三项在全身麻醉下进行。 未观察到严重不良事件、永久性神经功能缺损或术后认知能力下降。 在3至15个月的随访中，癫痫发作
结果各不相同。CM治疗的患者总体癫痫发作频率稳定，局灶性癫痫发作减少42.6%。后CC病变降低了半球间脑电同步性，并与全身性癫痫发作减少15.9%相关。HH病例显示脑电图上的癫痫样活动减少，胶质性癫痫发作减少55.5% ，尽管没有明确的病变。在ANT病例中，初始程序是DISCO
在达到治疗温度之前继续，全身麻醉下的重复治疗与最终随访时癫痫发作减少66.0 ％相关。
结论： MRgFUS在选定的癫痫相关靶点实现了病灶形成，包括首次报道的癫痫后部CC和CM应用。 然而，达到治疗温度和产生明确病变的能力因患者而异，
受解剖靶点的颅骨特征影响。鉴于小规模、异质性队列和有限的随访，观察到的临床结局应被认为是初步的。需要更大规模的研究以及更长的随访，以确定疗效并优化治疗参数。

papers.title: Brivaracetam for the termination of status epilepticus: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.title_zh: Brivaracetam用于终止癫痫持续状态：系统评价和荟萃分析。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Status epilepticus (SE) is an emergency neurological disorder which may lead to irreversible brain injury and death if not dealt with appropriately. About 30-50% of patients develop refractory SE due to failure to respond to the current antiseizure medications (ASMs). Recently, brivaracetam has been evaluated in studies to be implemented in management protocols. It showed promising efficacy similar to that of levetiracetam but better tolerability in SE patients in some studies, whereas it was less effective in other studies.
OBJECTIVE: To collect the available evidence about brivaracetam's efficacy and assess its possibility to be considered in the second-line medications in SE management protocol.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were carried out following PRISMA and Cochrane Collaboration standards. Studies evaluating brivaracetam in SE patients were searched in PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus till March 2026. Quality assessment was examined using Newcastle-Ottawa scale (NOS). Statistical analysis was conducted using a random-effects model in R software. The response rate outcome was pooled and expressed as event rates with 95% confidence intervals, and heterogeneity was calculated using I² and chi2 p statistics.
RESULTS: Ten studies were analyzed. The studies were heterogeneous in the number of previous medications before brivaracetam, the period between the onset of status epilepticus and brivaracetam administration, and the loading and maintenance doses of brivaracetam. The overall response rate was 0.52 (95% CI 0.45-0.59, p = 0.62), with moderate heterogeneity across studies (I2 = 41.61%, τ = 0.29, p = 0.045).
CONCLUSION: Brivaracetam could be an effective second-line drug with roughly half of patients achieving remission of status epilepticus. BRV administration within < 24 h with a dose range of 200-300 mg has been associated with treatment response. High-quality comparative RCTs are required to rank it within the current ASMs and define its place in SE protocols.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：癫痫持续状态（ SE ）是一种紧急神经系统疾病，如果处理不当，可能导致不可逆转的脑损伤和死亡。大约30-50%的患者由于对当前的抗癫痫药物（ ASM ）无反应而出现难治性SE。最近，在管理方案中实施的研究中评估了brivaracetam。它显示出与左乙拉西坦相似的有希望的疗效，但效果更好

papers.title: Impairment of ictal consciousness and psychosis in drug-resistant focal epilepsy: A retrospective clinical cohort study.
papers.title_zh: 耐药性局灶性癫痫中发作性意识障碍和精神病：一项回顾性临床队列研究。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Psychoses of epilepsy (POE) affect up to 13% of patients with focal epilepsy. Whereas interictal risk factors are well documented, ictal correlates of POE remain poorly characterized. We hypothesized that an impairment of ictal consciousness on the Consciousness Seizure Scale (CSS), would be associated with POE. We assessed the association between ictal clinical features and POE compared to non-POE in adults with drug-resistant focal epilepsy.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed a presurgical cohort of adults with drug-resistant focal epilepsy monitored by video-electroencephalography (EEG) or stereo-EEG. For each patient, all seizures with an examination allowing the completion of CSS score were included. POE were identified through standardized psychiatric interviews. Association between ictal features, primarily CSS score, and POE was tested using generalized estimating equations (GEE).
RESULTS: Among 232 included seizures (25 from POE group, 207 from non-POE group), the probability of POE varied nonlinearly with ictal consciousness; it peaked at intermediate CSS scores (GEE, OR = 4.31, p = .006). This effect remained after adjustment for duration of both epilepsy (OR=1.06, p = .005) and seizure (OR=1.20, p = .013). Intraclass correlation of CSS was .76 (95%CI, .65-.85), reflecting a low within-patient variance. An older age, more severe depressive and anxiety symptoms were also associated with POE.
SIGNIFICANCE: POE were associated with intermediate impairment of ictal consciousness, suggesting that partial disruption of awareness may favor the emergence of psychotic symptoms. The high level of intrapatient stability for CSS, mostly estimated from non-POE, suggests that CSS could be constant across seizures. This raises the possibility that POE risk could stem from the way consciousness is altered during seizures.

papers.title: Longitudinal serum and CSF cytokine dynamics in NORSE: Associations with immunotherapy exposure.
papers.title_zh: 挪威人的纵向血清和脑脊液细胞因子动力学：与免疫治疗暴露的关联。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To characterize serum and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) cytokine dynamics according to immunotherapy exposure in cryptogenic new-onset refractory status epilepticus (cNORSE).
METHODS: We analyzed cytokine profiles in 94 serum and 42 CSF samples from 29 and 14 patients, respectively, with cNORSE. Nine contributed both sample types, resulting in 34 patients. Samples were categorized according to immunotherapy exposure as no immunotherapy (NT), first-line (FL), and second-line (SL), and stratified by innate- or adaptive-directed therapies. SL represented cumulative exposure, as all SL samples followed initiation of both FL and SL therapies. Linear mixed-effects models accounted for repeated measures and time from cNORSE onset. A systematic literature review included 27 studies and 63 patients.
RESULTS: Serum cytokine levels were generally lower during FL (n = 24) than NT (n = 9), whereas most cytokines were higher during SL (n = 61) than FL. CXCL8 (C-X-C motif ligand 8)/IL-8 and CCL2 (C-C motif chemokine ligand 2) were higher during SL than FL, with CCL2 remaining significant after multiple-testing correction. No serum differences remained significant when analyses were restricted to samples collected 7-30 days after onset. CSF levels were generally lower during FL (n = 10) and SL (n = 25) than NT (n = 7). Innate-directed therapies were associated with higher serum IL-6, CXCL8/IL-8, and CCL2 and CSF IL-4, whereas adaptive-directed therapies were associated with lower CSF MIP-1α (Macrophage Inflammatory Protein-1 alpha). The association with higher serum IL-6 was no longer observed after excluding tocilizumab-treated patients. No temporal association after SL initiation or status epilepticus resolution remained significant after multiple-testing correction. The literature review showed more frequent reductions in pro-inflammatory cytokines in CSF than serum following immunotherapy initiation.
SIGNIFICANCE: Cytokine profiles in cNORSE differ by treatment exposure and compartment. Persistent serum inflammation during SL may reflect disease severity, systemic inflammation, treatment effects, or their combination, whereas CSF showed more consistent reductions after immunotherapy exposure. These findings highlight the importance of treatment timing and compartment when interpreting cytokine measurements and support prospective studies integrating baseline immune phenotypes and standardized clinical outcomes.

papers.title: Human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cortical neurons from monozygotic twins with the Gαo1 K278del mutation reveal disease mechanisms relevant to GNAO1-related encephalopathy.
papers.title_zh: 来自具有Gαo1 K278del突变的单卵双胞胎的人诱导多能干细胞衍生的皮质神经元揭示了与GNAO1相关脑病相关的疾病机制。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Rare de novo variants in GNAO1 cause a severe neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by a heterogenous display of early onset epilepsy, movement abnormalities, and global developmental delay. More than 100 pathogenic variants in GNAO1 have been identified and categorized into four groups according to their protein features. Most pathogenic variants affect both GNAO1 isoforms, whereas approximately 20% of patients have a GNAO1A-specific variant. Response to therapy is notoriously variable, even among patients harboring the same variant. Here, we set out to model GNAO1A-related encephalopathy using human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) from monozygotic twins carrying the Gαo1 K278del variant and uncovered-while taking advantage of the identical genomic setting-phenotypic features that further our understanding of the defects underlying the disorder.
METHODS: We generated hiPSCs expressing the c.832_834delAAG; p.K278del variant in GNAO1A obtained from monozygotic twins who both developed seizures 2 days after birth. For either twin, Gαo1 K278del and CRISPR-Cas9-repaired isogenic control hiPSC lines were differentiated into neural progenitor cells (NPCs) and subsequently into cortical neurons. Variant-specific transcriptomic, morphological, and electrophysiological characteristics were analyzed.
RESULTS: Gαo1 K278del mutated hiPSC-derived NPCs showed disorganized neural rosette structures and revealed an altered transcriptome. In cortical neurons, the Gαo1 K278del variant caused a reduction in the size and complexity of dendrites that was accompanied by an increase in pre- and postsynaptic puncta. Multielectrode array (MEA) recordings revealed an abnormal cortical neuron bursting activity pattern with fewer bursts and more spikes per burst. The antiepileptic drug levetiracetam reduced the spike frequency and the number of spikes per burst in cortical neurons from both patients.
SIGNIFICANCE: The developed GNAO1A hiPSC-derived in vitro model uncovered key structural and functional features of GNAO1-related encephalopathy. The comparable in vitro phenotypes in neurons from both twins underscore the utility of hiPSC-derived models to investigate molecular mechanisms underlying GNAO1-related encephalopathy as well as effects of therapeutic intervention.

papers.title: Implementation of the seizure code in a tertiary hospital: Effects on emergency care times and clinical outcomes in severe seizures.
papers.title_zh: 在三级医院实施癫痫发作代码：对严重癫痫发作中的紧急护理时间和临床结果的影响。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To assess the impact of implementing the Seizure Code (SC), a structured multidisciplinary emergency protocol for severe seizures, on care times and clinical outcomes at a tertiary hospital.
METHODS: Single-center, retrospective observational study including episodes of severe seizures in patients aged 18 years or older managed between January 2023 and December 2024, comparing pre-SC and post-SC periods. The primary outcome was time from seizure onset to administration of the first anti-seizure medication (ASM). Secondary outcomes included other care intervals, process indicators, and clinical outcomes. Care intervals were analyzed with accelerated failure time models (percentage change in median time), length of stay in a competing-risks framework, and binary outcomes with Firth-penalized logistic regression (odds ratios, OR), all adjusted for prespecified covariates and clustered by patient.
RESULTS: Of 1959 episodes identified, 378 (175 pre-SC, 203 post-SC) met SC activation criteria. Time to the first ASM, the primary outcome, did not differ significantly (27% shorter, 95% CI -15% to 53% for benzodiazepines; 27%, -6% to 50% for others). Time to urgent video-EEG (VEEG) was 48% shorter (29%-61%) and the neurological assessment-VEEG interval 63% shorter (31%-80%). Pre-notification by Emergency Medical Services increased (22.9% vs. 37.8%; p = 0.003). Hospital stay (7.48 vs. 5.08 days; subdistribution hazard ratio for discharge alive 1.36, 1.02-1.89) and intensive care unit stay (3.20 vs. 1.48 days) were shorter. Thirty-day seizure recurrence was lower (8.0% vs. 3.0%; adjusted OR 0.33, 0.12-0.84). Mortality and functional status at discharge did not differ.
SIGNIFICANCE: The primary outcome, time to first anti-seizure medication, was not significantly shorter after implementation of the structured emergency protocol. The observed benefits were concentrated in secondary process and resource-utilization indicators: implementation of the Seizure Code was associated with faster access to urgent VEEG, shorter hospital and intensive care unit stays, and lower 30-day seizure recurrence, without a significant effect on mortality. These findings support protocolized emergency pathways in severe seizures.
PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Severe seizures are emergencies in which fast, coordinated care matters. We compared how patients were treated at one hospital before and after a new protocol, the Seizure Code, was introduced. Afterwards, patients had urgent video-EEG (a recording of brain activity) sooner and spent fewer days in hospital and in the intensive care unit, and fewer had another seizure within 30 days. However, the time to the first anti-seizure medication did not change significantly, and deaths and disability at discharge were unchanged.

papers.title: Treatment patterns, strategies, and preferences after first anti-seizure medication failure in focal epilepsy: Findings from the SANAD and SANAD II trial cohorts and a survey of UK epilepsy specialists.
papers.title_zh: 局灶性癫痫首次抗癫痫药物治疗失败后的治疗模式、策略和偏好：来自SANAD和SANAD II试验队列的发现以及对英国癫痫专家的调查。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To describe treatment decisions after first anti-seizure medication (ASM) failure in focal epilepsy and describe how they have changed across two trial eras, and whether observed prescribing matched clinicians stated preferences.
METHODS: We analyzed the focal epilepsy cohorts from two UK pragmatic, randomized trials, Standard and New Antiepileptic Drugs (SANAD) (1999-2006) and SANAD II (2012-2019). Only initial ASM allocation was randomized; subsequent decisions reflected usual care, with medication changes and reason recorded prospectively. We reconstructed treatment sequences, classified first decisions after failure as switch or add-on, and stratified by reason, and compared prescribing with cross-sectional survey of UK epilepsy specialists.
RESULTS: Of those enrolled, 1644 of 1721 (95.5%) in SANAD and 933 of 990 (94.2%) in SANAD II were included. First-line ASM failed in 798 (48.5%) and 360 (38.6%), respectively. Among classifiable failures from inadequate seizure control (ISC), add-on was 40.9% (79/193) in SANAD and 63.1% (82/130) in SANAD II. After lamotrigine failure, the only randomized ASM in both trials, add-on was 44.4% (16/36) in SANAD to 74.3% (26/35) in SANAD II. Forty-six specialists completed the survey. Their preferred next ASM broadly matched SANAD II prescribing: after lamotrigine failure from ISC, 74% (31/42) chose levetiracetam, prescribed to 66% (23/35); after levetiracetam failure, 51% (21/41) chose lamotrigine, prescribed to 52% (26/50). Strategy preferences differed: respondents favored switching after each specified failure, yet add-on predominated after ISC in SANAD II.
SIGNIFICANCE: Add-on treatment after first ASM failure from ISC was more common in the later trial. Clinician-preferred next ASMs were consistent with observed practice, but preferred strategy did not. Neither trial was designed to compare these strategies, and cohorts differed in baseline characteristics and completeness of recorded reason for failure. Randomized evidence is needed to determine whether switching or add-on yields better seizure control, tolerability, and treatment-retention outcomes.

papers.title: Integrating uncertainty and practice variability for epilepsy prognostication after intracranial EEG: A meta-analysis.
papers.title_zh: 整合颅内脑电图后癫痫预后的不确定性和实践变异性：荟萃分析。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) practices and diagnostic testing vary among institutions, limiting standardization and optimization of surgical outcomes. This study estimates resection rates and surgical outcome effect sizes after iEEG and develops individual patient-level data (IPD) models using the missing-indicator method to approximate real-world clinical uncertainties and practice variability in iEEG and surgical decision-making.
METHODS: Databases were queried for studies reporting ≥12-month outcomes after epilepsy surgery in patients with drug-resistant epilepsy (DRE) who underwent iEEG. Random-effects meta-analysis estimated pooled outcome proportions. IPD analysis was performed using multivariable generalized linear regression and logistic regression models with cross-validation and calibration assessment. Missing values for key predictors were retained as a "not specified" category to evaluate the impact of incorporating uncertainty in common clinical data on outcome prediction.
RESULTS: Primary outcomes were seizure freedom (Engel class IA or International League Against Epilepsy [ILAE] 1) and favorable seizure outcomes (Engel I or ILAE 1-2). Of 4975 studies identified, 115 met the inclusion criteria. The pooled frequency of patients undergoing resection after iEEG was 67% (95% confidence interval [CI] 60%-74%), 52% achieved seizure freedom (95% CI 48%-56%), and 58% achieved a favorable outcome (95% CI 54%-62%). IPD analysis included 1305 patients from 29 studies and identified a lesional magnetic resonance imaging (MRI; odds ratio [OR] 1.94, CI 1.48-2.55, p < .0001) and a cortical malformation (OR 1.47, CI 1.08-2.00, p = .01) as independent predictors of a favorable outcome, whereas iEEG implantation strategy (bilateral implantation OR .61, 95% CI .42-.89, p = .01) was an independent predictor of a less favorable outcome.
SIGNIFICANCE: About two-thirds of patients undergoing iEEG proceeded to resection, and about half achieved seizure freedom. Multivariable models incorporating clinical uncertainty and practice variability were well calibrated. However, modest discrimination suggests that routinely available clinical variables alone have limited ability to predict individual surgical outcomes. More standardized and granular clinical and practice-related data may improve individualized prognostication after iEEG.

papers.title: Working memory supports cognitive control by orchestrating dimension-specific modulation during late conflict resolution.
papers.title_zh: 工作记忆通过在晚期冲突解决期间协调特定维度的调制来支持认知控制。
papers.abstract: Working memory plays a central role in cognitive control, yet how it shapes target- and distractor-related processing over time remains unclear. Here, we combined a working memory load manipulation with a modified Stroop task in which distractors preceded targets. Behaviorally, we found that pre-exposure to the distractor eliminated the congruency effect, but this benefit was absent under high load. This pattern suggests that the benefit of advance distractor presentation is sensitive to concurrent working-memory demands. Electrophysiologically, the distractor-locked lateralized readiness potential (LRP) indicated that working-memory load altered distractor-related response activation before target onset. After target onset, load-related modulation emerged during late conflict resolution, as indexed by the sustained potential (SP), whereas earlier intervals associated with attentional selection (posterior N2) and conflict monitoring (N450) did not show load-dependent modulation. Time-frequency decoding and representational similarity analysis further revealed distinct spectro-temporal profiles of target- and distractor-related processing: target-related coding emerged earlier in the theta band (540-780 ms), consistent with stimulus-response mapping, whereas distractor-related coding emerged later in the mu-beta band (870-1180 ms), consistent with response-related regulation. These findings highlight dimension- and stage-specific patterns of working-memory modulation during conflict resolution.

papers.title: Disrupted cortical signatures of response inhibition in Parkinson's disease revealed by TMS-EEG.
papers.title_zh: TMS-EEG揭示的帕金森病反应抑制的皮质特征中断。
papers.journal: Clinical neurophysiology : official journal of the International Federation of Clinical Neurophysiology
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Inhibitory control deficits are a hallmark of Parkinson's disease (PD), particularly in patients with L-DOPA-induced dyskinesias (LID), but the cortical mechanisms underlying impaired inhibition remain poorly understood. We used transcranial magnetic stimulation and electroencephalography (TMS-EEG) to investigate cortical dynamics during a Go/NoGo task in PD patients with and without LID, compared with healthy volunteers.
METHODS: Thirty-six PD patients (18 LID-PD, 18 nLID-PD) and 20 healthy volunteers performed a Go/NoGo task during TMS-EEG, which assessed functional connectivity between the supplementary motor area (SMA) and primary motor cortex (M1), and cortical reactivity through TMS-evoked potentials.
RESULTS: Healthy volunteers exhibited task-dependent modulation of SMA-M1 connectivity, with increased theta-band coupling during NoGo trials and gamma-band coupling during Go trials; this pattern was absent in both PD groups, particularly in those with dyskinesias. TMS-evoked potentials revealed enhanced N100 responses during NoGo trials in healthy volunteers, reduced in non-dyskinetic patients and absent in dyskinetic ones. SMA-M1 gamma connectivity correlated with motor performance and clinical severity. During post-TMS epochs, healthy volunteers showed context-dependent alpha/beta modulation that was disrupted in PD patients.
CONCLUSIONS: SMA-M1 communication and cortical inhibitory processing are impaired in PD, especially in patients with dyskinesias.
SIGNIFICANCE: SMA dysfunction may represent a biomarker and therapeutic target for inhibitory deficits in PD.

papers.title: Temporal coupling shapes the effects of prolonged muscle-tendon vibration on sensorimotor EEG activity during motor imagery.
papers.title_zh: 时间耦合塑造了运动成像过程中肌腱振动延长对感觉运动脑电活动的影响。
papers.abstract: Motor imagery (MI) recruits sensorimotor networks overlapping those engaged during physical execution and represents a promising rehabilitation tool. While concurrent afferent stimulation enhances MI-related cortical engagement, the effects of prolonged proprioceptive conditioning prior to MI remain unexplored. This study investigated whether prolonged muscle-tendon vibration (MTV) could modulate cortical activity during subsequent MI, indexed by electroencephalographic alpha- and beta-band event-related desynchronization (ERD). Twenty healthy adults performed imagined maximal isometric knee extensions before and after 20-minute suprapatellar MTV (100 Hz) or SHAM vibration (30 Hz with foam interface) in counterbalanced sessions. Cortical engagement was assessed via EEG burst detection over central electrodes (C3, Cz, C4). Maximal force capacity, submaximal force estimation performance, and cortical responses during combined MI and MTV were also evaluated. MTV induced stronger vibratory responses than SHAM, consistent with enhanced proprioceptive afferent activation. Following MTV, voluntary force outcomes showed near-threshold changes consistent with the expected direction, namely reduced maximal force capacity and altered submaximal force calibration, suggesting modified proprioceptive feedback. MI performed after MTV conditioning exhibited reduced alpha- and beta-band ERD compared to SHAM, with greater vibratory-induced responses being associated with a less pronounced post-vibration beta ERD. Conversely, when MI was performed concurrently with MTV following conditioning, alpha-band ERD increased selectively in the MTV session, with no modulation in the beta band. These findings suggest that prolonged proprioceptive conditioning modulates MI-related cortical engagement differently depending on the sensorimotor context in which imagery is performed. Such state-dependent effects may support distinct intervention strategies aimed either at recalibrating maladaptive sensorimotor patterns or at enhancing cortical recruitment in rehabilitation contexts.

papers.title: Comprehensive benchmarking of EEG biomarkers for Parkinson's disease: robustness, reliability, and clinical discriminability across multiple datasets.
papers.title_zh: 帕金森病脑电图生物标志物的综合基准：多个数据集的鲁棒性、可靠性和临床可辨识性。
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a high-temporal-resolution, noninvasive window into some of the abnormalities underlying Parkinson's disease (PD), yet reported electrophysiological biomarkers vary widely across studies due to differences in preprocessing, feature extraction, and analytical pipelines. Here we provide the first comprehensive, multi-dataset benchmarking of 16 EEG-derived biomarkers, including phase-amplitude coupling, beta burst metrics, aperiodic components, complexity measures, and beta waveform features, to evaluate their robustness, reliability, and clinical discriminability. Using three independent resting-state EEG datasets, with two preprocessing conditions evaluated for one dataset, we assessed the effects of preprocessing, window length, within-session variability, channel aggregation strategies, and clinical group differences (healthy controls vs. PD OFF-medication, healthy controls vs. PD ON-medication, and PD OFF- vs. ON-medication). Cross-dataset reproducibility of group-level effects was additionally evaluated using effect-size pattern similarity, biomarker rank concordance, effect-direction consistency, and random-effects meta-analysis. Aperiodic features, entropy and complexity measures, and fractal metrics demonstrated high methodological robustness across preprocessing methods, window lengths, and aggregation strategies, and several showed disease- and medication-related effects across datasets, although effect magnitude and statistical significance varied across datasets and analytical conditions. In contrast, oscillatory biomarkers, including beta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling, burst-derived metrics, and waveform-asymmetry features, showed substantial variability across methodological choices and lower within-session consistency. However, this methodological sensitivity should not necessarily be interpreted as lower biological relevance, as these measures may capture more transient or state-dependent physiological dynamics. Fully-denoised data improved group-level separability, for several biomarkers in Dataset 1. Together, these findings identify several biomarkers with comparatively strong methodological robustness for further biological and clinical validation and highlight methodological factors that contribute to inconsistencies in the PD literature. This benchmarking framework provides practical guidance for standardizing biomarker analysis while emphasizing that methodological robustness, biological sensitivity, and clinical utility represent distinct dimensions of biomarker performance.

papers.title: Coverage collapse and deceptive calibration in EEG fatigue monitoring: a cross-dataset audit under within-session and cross-subject shift.
papers.title_zh: 脑电疲劳监测中的覆盖范围崩溃和欺骗性校准：会期内和跨受试者转移下的跨数据集审计。
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography-based driver fatigue monitors are judged almost entirely on accuracy, yet a safety monitor is useful only if its stated confidence can be trusted when it is wrong. We audit whether it survives drift within a recording and transfer to a new person.Approach. Five model families, from a dense network to a gradient-boosted tree ensemble, run on three public corpora differing in channels, label instrument and elicitation. Calibration is measured pooled, per recording and per class, beside proper scoring rules. Seven conformal recalibration strategies are compared under one protocol, and we derive a ceiling on the coverage attainable by any rule thresholding a fixed calibration set.Main results. Pooled calibration error falls as accuracy falls, so the headline reliability metric improves as the model degrades. Aggregated per recording, the same predictions reverse it, exceeding the pooled estimate in all fifteen session-time bins of both continuously annotated corpora (sign test, p = 3.1 × 10⁻⁵); on the fatigued class the concealed error reaches 4.9 times the pooled value. Under transfer, class-balanced calibration error rises by 0.107 to 0.254 in all fifteen model-corpus cells, where coverage falls below its 0.90 target, to 0.533 at worst, with empty prediction sets in four. The ceiling held on all 32 subject streams and bound 20 below target, separating recoverable methods in advance. Rolling re-estimation under a finite-sample correction cleared it on 19 of those 20, held 0.886 to 0.909 in every cell, and cut between-subject coverage variability from 0.205 to 0.026 at constant update cost.Significance. Pooled calibration error and marginal coverage can both look healthy while a monitor is least reliable in the states that should raise an alarm. Three cheap diagnostics separate a calibrated monitor from one averaging failures of opposite sign, and one that covers from one that abstains.

papers.title: Mirror Neural System in Hands Motor Imagery with Pictures and Videos Guidance: An EEG-fNIRS Study.

papers.iso_journal: IEEE Trans Neural Syst Rehabil Eng
papers.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) achieved by motor imagery (MI) have been widely accepted as an effective tool in rehabilitative applications. Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) and electroencephalography (EEG) are two common implementation forms of BCIs, capable of monitoring neuronal potential changes and hemodynamic variations during different tasks. MI and action observation are often employed in therapeutic settings for patients with hemiplegia or other conditions that prevent actual movements. Decoding physiological signals during the imagination process plays a role in facilitating rehabilitation. However, the role of guided motor imagery in the imagination process has not been well studied. In this study, we compared the activation levels of oxygenated hemoglobin, the changes of neural activities' power in terms of time and frequency, and the differences and similarities of neural activations in the cortex area across seven different motor tasks under four conditions: motor execution (ME), MI, picture-guided motor imagery (PGMI) and video-guided motor imagery (VGMI). These findings demonstrate that although guided motor imagery (GMI) does not ease imagination tasks according to participant feedback, GMI reliably recruits mirror neurons during imagination when analyzing fNIRS and EEG signals. The results highlight that GMI has the potential to enrich BCI-based rehabilitation protocols for effectiveness enhancement.

papers.title: Participant-Disjoint EEG Decoding of Instructed Respiratory Conditions Using a Deep Spatio-Respiratory Transformer.
papers.title_zh: 使用深度空间呼吸变压器对指示呼吸状况进行参与者-分开的脑电图解码。
papers.journal: IEEE transactions on neural systems and rehabilitation engineering : a publication of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society
papers.iso_journal: IEEE Trans Neural Syst Rehabil Eng
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Fine-grained classification of instructed respiratory conditions from non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) remains challenging because of low signal-to-noise ratio and substantial inter-participant variability. This study proposes a Deep Spatio-Respiratory Transformer (DSRT) for EEG-based classification of instructed respiratory conditions.
METHODS: DSRT integrates differential entropy (DE) and normalized power-ratio (NPR) features, squeeze-and-excitation-based feature recalibration, a four-layer feature-token Transformer encoder, and auxiliary nasal/oral pathway supervision. The final task comprised eight respiratory-condition classes. The framework was evaluated using 64-channel EEG from 13 unique participants contributing 21 recording sessions. A fixed-count window-selection strategy was used to equalize the number of retained EEG windows across classes, and model evaluation was performed using participant-disjoint outer folds. Primary architecture comparisons and feature-representation analyses were conducted using participant-level performance summaries.
RESULTS: At the participant level, DSRT achieved an Accuracy of 0.7429 ± 0.0492. Compared with EEG Conformer, the strongest matched-input comparison architecture, DSRT improved Accuracy and Macro-F1 by 3.78 and 3.79 percentage points, respectively. Architectural ablation showed the largest performance reduction after removal of the Transformer encoder, while participant-level feature-sensitivity analysis showed that the combined DE-NPR representation outperformed either feature family alone. DSRT contained 1.297 million parameters and achieved a median window-to-prediction latency of 3.825 ms. Duration-matched analysis further identified spatially heterogeneous EEG differences associated with instructed nasal and oral breathing.
CONCLUSION: DSRT provides a participant-disjoint framework for fine-grained classification of EEG patterns associated with instructed respiratory conditions while retaining millisecond-scale inference. The findings support the utility of hybrid spectral representations and feature-token dependency modeling.

papers.title: Systematic review on the association between brain-related measures and upper limb movement characteristics after stroke.
papers.title_zh: 卒中后大脑相关指标与上肢运动特征相关性的系统综述。
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Upper limb (UL) movements are highly diverse, as are movement deficits following stroke. The relationship that stroke pathology has with UL impairments and their recovery has been studied with an increasingly complex array of neuroimaging and neurophysiology tools. This systematic review summarizes evidence on brain-related measures and UL movement in subjects with stroke.
METHODS: Bibliographic databases were systematically searched for combinations of 'brain function' and 'kinematics/ kinetics/ muscle activity' and 'stroke' and 'upper limb'. Studies were included if both brain and UL movement measures were assessed in at least 10 subjects. Each study was evaluated for risk of bias (adapted QUADAS-2 tool). Information on assessments for brain and UL measures, their associations, and experimental tasks was extracted, summarized, and synthesized. This study was registered on PROSPERO (CRD42025637373).
RESULTS: A total of 220 studies were included that reported 288 experimental tasks across 4'954 subjects with stroke (mean 59.7 years). Transcranial magnetic stimulation, functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), and electroencephalography, commonly combined with grip force sensors and motion sensor- or camera-based systems, were the most frequently used methodologies. Overall, 92 brain-related and 201 UL metrics were assessed. Risk of bias was low-to-moderate. Structural brain measures revealed associations between corticospinal tract integrity and greater grip strength, as well as kinematic differences between left- and right-hemisphere stroke locations. For functional brain measures, increased activation of ipsilesional motor areas during fMRI was associated with improved smoothness. In addition, studies reported reduced activation intensity and excitability after stroke, alongside task-related recruitment of additional brain areas.
DISCUSSION: This review summarizes a large and heterogeneous body of research reflecting substantial methodological and technological advances in the assessment of brain and UL movement measures after stroke. The current findings support the relevance and utility of combining brain-based and UL metrics to identify meaningful associations between neurological injury, brain function, and behavioral outcomes after stroke and thereby provide an improved understanding of movement after stroke.

papers.title: Recurrent latent dynamics in spinal circuits enable a digital twin of autonomic state transitions.
papers.title_zh: 脊髓回路中的反复潜伏动力学使自主状态转换的数字孪生成为可能。
papers.abstract: Physiological signals underlying homeostasis, such as blood pressure, are dynamic and nonlinear, shaped by interactions among diverse neurons. In the spinal intermediolateral nucleus (IML), neurons show heterogeneous, monotonic firing changes during blood pressure transitions, intrinsic to control yet difficult to decode. We introduce a manifold-based model reconstructing internal state dynamics from IML activity, beyond prior descriptive frameworks. Brief spinal stimulation lowering blood pressure showed that single-neuron responses could not explain the nonlinear trajectory, so we derived a low-dimensional circular manifold capturing its cyclical evolution. Embedding the manifold as a dynamic reservoir in a recurrent neural network reconstructed trial-to-trial variability and nonlinear blood pressure dynamics generated by the manifold, without a readout. Our results establish the neural manifold as a generative computational substrate for autonomic physiology, a capability that remains largely unexplored in spinal circuits, and a step toward closed-loop spinal neuromodulation.

papers.title: Advancing Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Depression: Novel Protocols, Precision Targeting, and Future Directions.
papers.title_zh: 推进针对抑郁症的重复性经颅磁刺激：新方案、精确定位和未来方向。
papers.abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) remains a significant global health challenge, with substantial limitations inherent in current pharmacotherapeutic and psychotherapeutic approaches. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has emerged as a safe, effective, and non-invasive neuromodulation therapy, particularly for treatment-resistant depression (TRD). However, conventional rTMS is limited by long treatment duration and variable interindividual efficacy. This expert opinion examines recent advances in rTMS optimization strategies aimed at overcoming these limitations. Key areas of progress include the development of novel stimulation protocols such as theta-burst stimulation (TBS); accelerated regimens and priming TMS; the use of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-guided TMS; and the integration of closed-loop systems using real-time electroencephalography (EEG) or functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) feedback. Additionally, technological innovations, including robot-assisted TMS and wearable devices, promise to enhance targeting accuracy and treatment accessibility. Despite these developments, significant challenges impede clinical translation, including the high cost of personalized protocols, insufficient standardization and validation of novel approaches, and technical barriers to closed-loop implementation. Future efforts should focus on cost reduction, large-scale randomized controlled trials, biomarker development, and device portability. Ultimately, optimized rTMS shows significant potential to become a more efficient, precise, and accessible cornerstone of depression therapy.
